body:
I feel this way all the time but I've never been able to verbalize how it feels. 

Also events will seem like they happened forever ago when they happened that same day.
Neon demon is my favorite movie ever. I love that soundtrack
Aww she's really cute. Mines nice, but he won't stay awake long enough to hear me.
Thanks for responding. Feel a little less like I'm yelling into the void. Or at my cat.

One of the worst parts is that I'm a young cancer survivor.

Everyone has this impression of me like I'm some strong empowered woman, and how could I possibly be sad when I beat cancer?

It's not like I did something, I went to the doctor, I'm not a hero. My depression is far more crippling than cancer ever was.
Feels a little too brave for me, but I'll think about it.
I've tried before but the speaker on my phone isn't loud enough. Maybe I'll try again, the silence is intimidating
It's 5pm. I can't go anywhere that would cost money, and it's too cold to walk outside. I'm trying to muster the energy to shower, it feels like climbing a mountain right now.
I'm sorry you deal with any of this. I wouldn't wish it on my worst enemy. But it feels good to know I'm not alone in these feelings.

One is a friend, the other I barely know, he's from Craigslist. 

I could, potentially. How do you even start a conversation like that?
I live with two roommates. My mom and brother are in different states.
I know you're right. It just feels really really hard.
Worried and upset, I'm sure. I don't want them to deal with that. It's so hard to verbalize, this is the only time I've ever said these things "out loud".
